beaches.name: Eristos
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established at the far south-eastern end, beyond the taverna. A June 2022 directory report describes Greek-language signposting of the nude area and says the beach is supported by the local council; earlier reports run from 2003. The rest of the beach is swimwear and topless.

beaches.name: Plaka (northern end)
beaches.summary: The northern end is used for nude bathing. A naturist directory carries reports from 2003 and 2011 describing an official 'Nudism area' sign; a charter-company guide instead reports a 'no nudism' sign with naturist use continuing at the far end. No directory report newer than 2011 is documented.
